goal: Score reviewer configurations against the eval corpus with an offline runner, record the baseline of the current single-reviewer pipeline, publish a record-based review-quality report, record per-round review timestamps so review duration is measurable, and add session-visible quality metrics to the imm-retro analyzer within its existing counting rules and boundary.

acceptance.assertion: Meet S1 in docs/specs/review-verifier-eval.spec.md: the runner scores a reviewer configuration per gold case (recall over confirmed_true by anchor or location match, false positives as blocking findings on clean cases plus confirmed_false matches, unknown anchors as new-anchor rate, unlabeled cases never in a denominator); a baseline run for the current pipeline is committed under benchmark-results/review-eval and its numbers are recorded in the corpus README; the record-based report computes, from committed audit records only and never live .imm state, rounds-to-pass median and p95, the resolved / refuted / accepted_risk disposition mix, the security_boundary share of blocking findings, and advisory count per pass; the imm-retro analyzer additionally reports per author model the blocking split by violated.kind and refute / resolve / accept-residual-risk event counts only where a committed fixture proves the event is visible in session logs; a fixture without violated.kind yields the pre-change report unchanged; the merge gate is written down with it: recall not lower, clean-case false-positive rate not higher, rounds-to-pass p95 not higher, and recall wins any trade-off. It also carries the Jev supplement (spec item 6): a security_boundary mislabel rate from offline classification of each blocking finding's violated.kind, experimental until scored against the S0 gold cases, never changing a finding, record, or admission. It also carries the per-acceptance repeat-count series (spec item 7): per acceptance ID, rework-finding count across rounds and rounds since last finding, from committed records only; it decides nothing by itself. It also carries the review timing instrumentation (spec item 8): the coordinator records per review round the reservation-creation and verdict-submission timestamps, and the report publishes dispatch-to-verdict duration median and p95 from rounds carrying both, pre-change records unmeasured, never zero; nothing gates on them.
